Jwt._comment: Jwt:Key is required at startup. Set it via user-secrets (dotnet user-secrets set "Jwt:Key" ... --project src/Hosts/YallaJo.Api) or the Jwt__Key environment variable.

ExternalAuth._comment: Shared HMAC-SHA256 secret with the Web BFF (must match the Web project's ExternalAuth:SigningKey). Set via user-secrets (dev) or the ExternalAuth__SigningKey environment variable (prod). Minimum 32 bytes.

ContentBlogs._comment: HMAC-SHA256 key for content_blogs.BlogViews.ViewerHash. REQUIRED at startup. Set via user-secrets (dev) or the ContentBlogs__ViewerHashSecret environment variable (prod).

AzureTranslator._comment: Server-only key — set via user-secrets (dev) or the AzureTranslator__SubscriptionKey environment variable (prod).

Gmail._comment: AppPassword is server-only — set via user-secrets (dev) or the Gmail__AppPassword environment variable (prod).

Retention._comment: Background cleanup of disposable Auth state. Enabled MUST be true on exactly one host (the API host) so the sweep runs from a single place; the Web host sets it false. Session/RefreshToken retention windows keep a short-term security-review surface and preserve refresh-token reuse detection (revoked tokens must remain queryable to catch replays).

Weather._comment: Upstream weather provider config (WeatherAPI.com). To enable, set Provider='weatherapi' and supply ApiKey via user-secrets (dev) or environment variables (prod): Weather__Provider, Weather__ApiKey. Defaults target the WeatherAPI.com Free plan: 100,000 calls/month and a 3-day forecast cap. Raise ForecastDays only on a paid plan (Starter=7, Pro+=300).
